rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a verbal riddle or puzzle.

example.english: This riddle is so hard—I thought about it all night and still couldn't figure out the answer.
example.traditional: 呢條謎語好難，我諗咗成晚都諗唔到答案。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 mai4 jyu5 hou2 naan4 ngo5 nam2 zo2 seng4 maan5 dou1 nam2 m4 dou3 daap3 on3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction when an object is described as being full of undesirable things such as errors.

example.jyutping: seng4 pin1 man4 zoeng1 dou1 hai6 co3 zi6

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that undesirable things pervade or overrun the object, especially in more formal wording.

example.jyutping: co3 ng6 cung1 cik1 seng4 pin1 man4 zoeng1
